finding.description: A direct Identity Platform provider config readback returned the Google OAuth provider clientSecret field in command output. The value is not repeated or stored in this file.

acceptableClosures: Rotate the affected OAuth client secret and re-read provider config with a sanitized field mask.
Product owner explicitly accepts the residual risk for this internal-only release gate.
requiredResolution.notes: Future provider readback must use field masks or post-processing that never prints clientSecret.
